text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The journey of Sheffy and the group watching from the sidelines to gather ingredients for the New Year's osechi finally reached its climax, as they arrive to their final destination... the Margen Coast.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィと、それを隠れて見守る一同のおせち材料集めの旅は
いよいよ大詰めを迎え、最後の目的地である
マルジェン海岸へと到着する。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: This is the Margen Coast... What I need to gather from here are some clamshells from the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここが
マルジェン海岸……
浜でハマグリっていう貝を手に入れればいいのね。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I wonder where I should buy some... Um! Excuse me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どこで買えばいいのかしら……
あ
の！　
すみません！

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: What is it?
text_block_list.orig_text: なんじゃ？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Um, I'd like to buy some clams. Do you know where they sell them?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
ハマグリが欲しいんですけど、
どこで売ってるか分かりますか？

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: You too, huh? Normally, at this time of year, we fishermen would be selling them on the beach...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お主もか……
普段ならば
今の時期はワシら漁師が浜で売っておるのじゃがのう……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Could it be...
text_block_list.orig_text: もしかして……

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but they were all bought up yesterday and we don't have any clams left for sale...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すまぬが、
昨日買い占められて
売り物のハマグリはもうないんじゃよ……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Can't something be done to get more? I really happen to need them...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとかなりませんか？
どうしても必要なんです……

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it seems that you've got your reasons. Go ahead and tell me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ、
訳ありのようじゃのう。
話してみなされ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Actually...
text_block_list.orig_text: 実は……

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: I see. You can actually harvest some from the beach itself, but nobody wants to go fishing these days.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほどのう。
浜で採ることはできるんじゃが、
今はみな漁には出たがらんのでのう。

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: There's a monster living on the beach as of late. Normally, the men of the sea don't fear monsters, but that particular one is really formidable...
text_block_list.orig_text:
浜に魔物が棲みついておるんじゃ。
普段なら魔物も恐れぬ海の男たちじゃが、
あの魔物はどうにも手ごわくてのう……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: If I went and picked them by myself... would it be fine?
text_block_list.orig_text: 私が採りに行っちゃダメですか？

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: I've just told you... There's a dangerous monster out there. Very dangerous, so don't be reckless.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言うたじゃろう……
魔物が出るんじゃ。
危ないからやめておきなされ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Even so, I still need to gather them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでも、
必要なんです！

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: I see that there's no real sense in stopping you in your tracks... All right, do as you please. Just make sure to run away if you think it's dangerous.
text_block_list.orig_text:
止めても無駄そうじゃの……
わかった、
好きにしなされ。
ただ、
危ないと思ったら
すぐ逃げるのじゃぞ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, pal!
text_block_list.orig_text: ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Umm, I'm glad that I know where to look now, but... I wonder how to pick clams...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
来たのはいいけど……
ハマグリって
どうやって採ればいいのかしら……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I couldn't help but move on impulse. I acted kind of like Pecorine would've...
text_block_list.orig_text:
つい勢いで動いちゃった。
なんだかペコリーヌさんみたい……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: But this is the end of my journey, and I absolutely do not want to give up. I have to do something...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
ここで最後なんだから、
絶対に諦めたくなんかないもの。
なんとかしなくちゃ……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Anyway, if they can be harvested on the beach, that means they're in the sand. I guess a sword would be good for digging up sand in the ocean...
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりあえず、
浜で採れるってことは
砂の中にいるってことよね。
海の中の砂を掘るには、
剣でいいかな……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: If the tip of my sword hits something hard, it must be a shell. What is this? I feel a strange presence...
text_block_list.orig_text:
剣の先に
硬いもの当たったら
貝のはず。
なんだろう。
なんだか
異様な気配が……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Did something just grab the tip of my sword...? Is this... a tentacle?
text_block_list.orig_text:
剣先が何かにつかまれた……？
これって
触手？

text_block_list.name: 魔物
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: A monster! Was it burrowed under the sand?! Come to think of it, I heard that Kokkoro-san was also caught by tentacles in this same coast...
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物！　
砂の中にもぐってたの！？
そういえば、
コッコロさんが捕まったのも触手だって聞いたわね……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: What should I do...? I've been told to run away if it's dangerous...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしよう……
逃げろ、
って
言われたけど……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Aaah! That thing's huge but it sure isn't slow...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃあっ！
あんなに大きいのに素早い……！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: However it's also surrounded by seawater... If that’s the case, I’ll freeze its surroundings and stop it from moving!
text_block_list.orig_text:
周囲は海水……
だったら、
凍らせて動きを封じる！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's keep going...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし！　
このまま……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: It broke the ice using another tentacle? Eek!
text_block_list.orig_text:
別の足で氷が砕かれた？
き
ゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Each and every tentacle attacks as if it were a separate creature... This monster is really strong!
text_block_list.orig_text:
足の一本一本が
全部別の生き物みたいに襲ってくる……
この魔物、
本当に強い！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Sheffy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ！　
シェフィちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: That monster is even bigger than the same type we fought back then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの魔物、
わたくしたちが戦ったものよりも大きいのでは……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I remember that back then you were caught Korosuke, and it sure was a close call...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの時は
コロ助が捕まって危なかったのよね……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: At this rate...
text_block_list.orig_text: このままじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Don't panic so frantically. You were the ones who said you believed in Sheffy, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おたおたするんじゃないよ。
シェフィを信じるって言ったのは
アンタたちだろう？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: It's your job as her guildmates to watch over and believe in her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
信じて見守るのも
また仲間の仕事じゃ。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: However...
text_block_list.orig_text: ですが……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Of course, if things get really dangerous, I'll go to her rescue myself. But look... see the expression on Sheffy's face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん、
本当に危なくなったら
助けに行くさ。
でも、
見てごらんよ。
あのシェフィの顔を。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Sheffy...
text_block_list.orig_text: シェフィ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: That expression is the one of someone who hasn't given up just yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの顔は、
まだ諦めた顔ではないのう。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Hang in there, Sheffy-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
がんばれ、
シェフィちゃん……！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Miss Sheffy...
text_block_list.orig_text: シェフィさま……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Don't give up...
text_block_list.orig_text: 諦めちゃダメ……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: If it was anyone else from the Gourmet Guild here, they'd never give up... I'M SHEFFY! AND I'M ALSO FROM THE GOURMET GUILD!
text_block_list.orig_text:
【美食殿】のみんななら、
絶対に諦めないから……
私だって、
【美食殿】のシェフィなんだから！！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Absolutely... I absolutely won't give up!! I will definitely gather around an happy dinner table with everyone and welcome the new year!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
絶対に……
諦めない！！
絶対にみんなと、
幸せな食卓を囲むんだっ！！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Anyway, the number of tentacles the opponent has is troublesome... So I'll freeze the places where the tentacles gather and stick them together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく
相手の本数が厄介だから……
触手同士が集まったところを凍らせて
くっつける！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: As long as I can reduce the number of tentacles, I'll be able to move more easily! The main body's movements isn't too fast... I can defeat it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
触手の本数さえ減らせれば
こちらの動きにも余裕ができるわ！
本体の動き自体は速くない……
私なら、
倒せる！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: TAKE THISSSSSSSSSSSSSS!
text_block_list.orig_text: こっのおおおお！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I did it...!
text_block_list.orig_text: やった……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Yay! She really did it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった！　
やりましたよ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: I'm impressed...
text_block_list.orig_text: さすがでございます……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Well done, Sheffy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よくやったわ、
シェフィ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: See, she really beat that thing all by herself. Even so, it's very impressive.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に一人で倒しちまった。
それにしても
たいしたもんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: It was quite a monster. Even I might have had a hard time fighting it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なかなかの魔物じゃったのう。
わらわですら苦戦したやもしれぬぞ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: You believed in her and watched over her growth... isn't that nice?
text_block_list.orig_text:
信じて見守ってて
よかったじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!
text_block_list.orig_text: はい！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: On my part... I am deeply moved.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたくし、
感動しております……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Well, I've always believed in her, personally.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
あたしは信じてたけどね。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Geez, Kyaru you're so dishonest!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
キャルちゃんってばぁ！

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh, there was a really loud sound, so I came over...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
なにやらすごい音がするので来てみれば……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Grandpa...
text_block_list.orig_text: お爺さん……

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: Still, what a gigantic octopus it is... I haven't seen such a big one since the Gourmet Guild members defeated that one a long time ago.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし、
なんとも巨大なタコじゃのう……
これほどの大物、
以前【美食殿】の方々が倒したとき以来じゃよ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Huh...? "The Gourmet Guild members", you say...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……？　
【美食殿】のみんなが……？

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: To have defeated it all by yourself is--Well, nothing short of impressive. But why did you challenge such a powerful monster all by yourself?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それを一人で倒すとは、
いや、
おみそれしました。
しかしなぜこれほどの魔物に
一人で挑まれたのですかな？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: That's, probably for... my own gluttony, I suppose?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは多分……
食い意地、
かな？

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.orig_text: なんですと？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Me too... I'm a part of the Gourmet Guild.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も、
【美食殿】なんです。

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: Hohoho, that's surprising to hear! Why don't you take a rest for a while?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほっほっほ、
それはなんとも！
しばし
休んでいかれませんかな？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: But I still have to pick those clams...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
ハマグリを採らないと……

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: Now that the beach is safe, the fishermen can go out fishing with peace of mind. It is also the least we can do to show our gratitude to you, so please leave the clam harvesting to us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
浜も安全になったゆえ、
漁師たちも安心して漁に出られます。
せめてものお礼です。
ハマグリ採りは
我々にお任せください。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Well then... I guess I'll take you up on your offer... I'll take a break for a bit...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ……
お言葉に甘えようかな……
少し、
休ませてもらうわ……

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: All the fishermen in the village went to the trouble of catching these clams. Are you sure that you're only going to grab this meager amount for yourself?
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかく村の漁師総出で採ってきたのですが、
持っていかれるハマグリは
それだけでよいのですかな？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yes. This is more than enough. Besides, I got some spare octopus tentacles to take back home with me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
これだけあれば十分だわ。
それに、
タコの足ももらったし……

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: That creature was defeated by you alone, Sheffy-san. You have the right to take the entire thing back home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれはシェフィさんが倒したものですから
全部持っていってもよろしいのですよ？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: No. I couldn't possibly carry a creature of that size back home by myself. And more importantly, delicious food shouldn't be monopolized by anyone, it should be shared with everyone else at the table... That's what the Gourmet Guild is all about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ。
そもそも大きすぎて運べないし。
何より、
美味しいものは独り占めしないで、
みんなで分け合う……
それが【美食殿】だもの。

text_block_list.name: Old man
text_block_list.text: Hohoho, I see. Then I'll gladly host a dinner table myself and share it with the people of the beach. Well then, have a good year.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほっほっほ、
なるほど。
ありがたく浜の者たちで分けさせていただきます。
それでは、
良いお年を。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yes. Have a good year.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
よいお年を。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Now I have all the ingredients for the New Year's osechi. I also got some extras to spare...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで、
おせちの材料は全部揃ったわ。
色々おまけも増えちゃったけど……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Now all that's left is to return to everyone. It was a long, but also short, journey.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あとは、
みんなのところに戻るだけ。
長かったようで
短い旅だったわね。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Oh, young lady. That's quite a load you have there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おやお嬢さん。
すごい荷物だねえ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yes. I did my best to gather all those things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
一生懸命集めたの。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: It looks like ingredients for a New Year's osechi. It's quite an accomplishment to gather that much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おせち料理の材料みたいだねえ。
それだけの量集めるのはたいしたもんだ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Huh? I feel like I've seen your face before...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう。
あれ、
あなたの顔、
どこかでみたような……

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so? I think there's about 50 people in Landosol who look just like me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうかい？
俺に似たやつなんてランドソルには50人はいると思うぜ？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I wonder about that... Even so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうかしら……
でも……

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Uuuuugh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっ……
うううううっ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
なに？　
どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, my stomach... Owowowow...
text_block_list.orig_text:
急にお腹が……
いたた
たた……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Oh no. Wait right there. I'll call for someone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
大変。
待ってて。
今だれか人を……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And in an instant... it happened.
text_block_list.orig_text: それは、一瞬の出来事だった。

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: A monster?! Watch out, run away...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物！？
危ない、
逃げて……！

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: That's right, I'll run away for sure... from YOU, that is! Heave ho!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだな、
逃げさせてもらうぜ──
お前からな！　
よっと！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: He's straddling a monster...! What's going on? Are you a monster user?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物にまたがった……！　
どういうこと！？
あなた、
魔物使いなの？

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess that's what I am. Still, you've gathered quite a bit of fine stuff.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
そういうこった。
にしてもずいぶんと上物を集めたもんだな。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Ah...! That's...! That's my luggage!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
それ、
私の荷物！？

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: I'll be taking this. Hey! Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつはもらっておくぜ。
おい！　
行くぞ！

text_block_list.name: Cow Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Kyaa!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃあっ！

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha! A job well done, partner! See ya then, farewell!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーっはっはっはー！
さすがだぜ相棒！
じゃあな、
あばよ～！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: The ingredients... I've gathered for everyone's osechi! I have to chase after them... Ow...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなの、
おせちの材料が！
追いかけないと……
いたっ……！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I sprained my leg...! I let my guard down because I was able to defeat that octopus by myself... What should I do...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
足、
挫いちゃってる……！
あのタコを一人で倒せたからって油断してた……
どうしよう……！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAAAAHN?! Hey, what?? Huh? What just happened?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあああああ！？
ちょ、
なに？？　
え？　
どういうこと？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: How could this happen...?
text_block_list.orig_text: なんということでしょう……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Sheffy!
text_block_list.orig_text: シェフィちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Wait what?! Surely we have to go rescue Sheffy right now, don't we?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なによ！　
今すぐシェフィのところにいってやんなきゃダメでしょ！？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That's right! I'm sure that she's shocked now that such a thing has happened!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですよ！　
あんなことがあったら
絶対ショックなはずです！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: This isn't the time to be talking about operations or whatever!
text_block_list.orig_text: 作戦なんて言ってる場合じゃないでしょ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: My Lord, are you saying that so that Lady Sheffy's efforts won't go to waste? But even so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィさまの頑張りを無駄にしないため、
でございますか？
しかし、
それでも……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Auh... sniff... uuh... uh... ugh... ooh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あう
っ……
ぐすっ……
うっ……
うっ……
ううっ……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I can't... Just sitting here and crying, I won't stand this...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ……
ダメ。
　こんなところで泣いてるだけなんて、
ダメなんだから……！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I... have to do something...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私が、
なんとかしないと……！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Aaah... Lady Sheffy is crying all by herself... How pitiful...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
シェフィさまが泣いてしまわれております……
なんとおかわいそうな……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ah... Kokkoro-chan, look...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
コッコロちゃん、
見てください……！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Sitting here and crying won't accomplish anything... I have to go and chase after that villain...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここで座ってても、
なんにもならないわ……
追いかけないと……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: All I know is the general direction they went... But... I have no choice but to go...
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってるのは
方向だけ……
それでも……
行くしかない……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I'll take those ingredients back... I swear it...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
取り返すんだ……
絶対に……！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Sheffy... You're so impressive, standing up all by yourself...
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィさま……
お一人で立ち上がられて、
なんてご立派な……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Still, that irritating man...! To think he was a monster user... I'll never forgive him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしてもあのムカつく男……！
魔物使いだったなんて……
絶対許さないんだから！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Let us also go ahead and chase after that man and his monster that just attacked her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしたちは
先回りして魔物とさっきの人を追いかけましょう！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hold on. We'll take care of that.You guys just keep watching over Sheffy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ちな。
そっちはアタシたちに任せてもらうよ。
アンタたちは
このままシェフィを見守っておきな。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: That lowlife is the one who's bought out all those items all over the world... Fear not, I've already sent my minions after him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あやつ、
あの時の買い占め犯じゃったな……
安心せい、
既に眷属を放ち、
後をつけさせておる。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Ruka, Lady Illya... Even so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルカさま、
イリヤさま……
ですが……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: This happened even though she was under our watch. Can you give us a chance to make up for it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシたちがついていながら
こんなことになっちまったんだ。
挽回のチャンスをくれないかい？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Umu... That lowlife has to stop messing around... I won't let him get away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ……
ふざけた真似をしおって……
絶対に逃がさぬぞ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Sheffy's determined to see things through to the end. You guys should share that determination to also watch over her until the end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィは覚悟をもって
最後までやり遂げようとしてるんだ。
お前さんたちも覚悟をもって
最後まで見守ってやりな。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. Kyaru, Kokkoro, and I will watch over Sheffy! {0}-kun, please go and help them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……分かりました。
シェフィちゃんは
わたしとキャルちゃん、
コッコロちゃんで見守ります！
{0}くんは、
お二人を手伝ってあげてください。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: You absolutely can't let him get away! Okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
絶対に逃がすんじゃないわよ！
いい？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Sheffy's journey to gather ingredients for the New Year's osechi is engulfed in unexpected turmoil...
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィのおせち材料集めの旅は
思わぬ波乱へ飲み込まれるのであった……
